messages:
nina: quick sync on Optimize toolkit beta — customer B wants fast win: route-level presets for batching + cache hints, plus a lightweight eval-alert that emails SRE. theyre NOT ready for automatic quant changes.
oscar: agree, keep auto-apply out of v1. two tracks: Ops UX (presets + UI) and Eval infra (alerting + threshold config). ship UI + simple webhook first.
priya: product ask: include a cost-estimate card per-recommendation (ballpark savings). that reduces friction for manual acceptance.
ben: engineering reality: batching presets + cache hints are small. cost-estimate requires we model token distribution; can approximates with recent 7-day token-per-route averages. eval alerts need a baseline eval set per customer.
hao: timeline: if we scope to presets + cache hints + eval webhook + cost-estimate card (non-blocking accuracy) -> ~5 weeks for alpha. full QA + docs => 8 weeks to beta.
poscar: (typo) ^oscar: we should add an opt-in flag per-customer so we don't surprise any tenants.
priya: launch criteria proposal: 
- customer-specified eval-set configured for alerting
- alert precision > 90% on internal sims
- cost-estimate within +/- 30% for 95% of routes
- feature-flagged and can rollback in 15m window
ben: acceptance seems reasonable. operational gating: must add an escape hatch to pause alerts per-route.
hao: infra checklist: 
- route-level config table (presets + cache TTLs)
- metric export for token counts and latency (per-route p50/p95)
- eval-alert service -> webhook/email/slack
- UI card w/ manual-accept flow for quant recs

code example for presets: 
```
optimize_toolkit:
  presets:
    conservative: {max_tokens: 2048, max_latency_ms: 30}
    balanced:     {max_tokens: 8192, max_latency_ms: 75}
    aggressive:   {max_tokens: 32768, max_latency_ms: 250}
```

nina: sales note: we'll tell customer B: "beta includes recommendations + manual apply; automation coming in v2" — get explicit signoff.
oscar: docs: add a short README for SRE runbook (how to mute alerts, revert a route config). priya: also include examples for quant card wording.
ben: QA plan: synthetic traffic with long prefixes to validate KV caching TTL; simulate int8 effects by rounding logits to ensure recommendation card doesn't show huge regressions.
hao: rollout: feature-flag to 2 test customers, then 20% of hosted traffic, 48h observation window, then wider. rollback automation built into canary pipeline.
deploy-bot: Please create feature flag "optimize-beta-light" and add canary rule for customer IDs [cust-b-test-1, cust-b-test-2]. :robot_face:
